subject: Cross-region offer floor escalation - Bengaluru candidate
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cross-region offer floor escalation - Bengaluru candidate

Hi team,

Following up from our loop yesterday about the Senior ML Engineer candidate in Bengaluru (Priya Singh). Recruiting is seeing a hard market locally and the candidate has a competing offer from a mature startup that's ~12% above the standard US-equivalent offer we typically bring for this role. The candidate is strong (profile attached) and Karthik believes immediate replacement risk is medium-high.

Request: can we approve a one-time cross-region adjustment to the base offer for this hire? Proposed options:
- Option A (recommended): bump base by 12% relative to the standard band (effectively move to top of band + COLA uplift).
- Option B: keep base within band but add a 12% sign-on bonus paid 50% on start / 50% after 6 months.

Impact (high-level):
- Annual run-rate delta (Option A): +12% on comp budget for this headcount (~USD 13.2k incremental run-rate, see attached calc).
- One-time cost (Option B): sign-on bonus ~USD 16k (no run-rate impact).

Why now:
- Candidate has given a soft deadline (end of next week). Recruiting flagged retention risk if we stretch the timeline.
- This hire is for a product-critical role supporting latency optimization work; delaying is likely to push timelines on the model-serving roadmap.

Approvers needed: Ben (recruiting/geo escalation), Marissa (People Ops), Evelyn (Comp & Benefits). Please advise which option you prefer and any additional approvals required (finance, headcount owner). I attached the compensation calculation and candidate CV.

Attachments: comp_econ_calc.xlsx, candidate_cv.pdf

Thanks,
Karthik
Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cross-region offer floor escalation - Bengaluru candidate

Karthik / Marissa —

Thanks for the clear write-up. I’m inclined to approve Option B (sign-on) immediately to avoid ratcheting the ongoing run-rate unless we believe this is a precedent we need to set for the whole Bangalore hiring slate. Two quick asks before I sign off:

1) Evelyn — can you confirm whether a 12% sign-on for this band is consistent with local practice (tax treatment, gross vs net implications)?
2) Marissa — do we have headcount/funding in the current quarter for this role? If not, can you confirm the budget owner (product infra) is OK?

If both are OK, I’ll approve the sign-on and ask recruiting to move to offer. If comp team pushes back and prefers base uplift, flag that here and I’ll escalate to finance for one-time exception.

Short reply is fine — candidate timing is tight.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Sales & GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, comp_signoff@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cross-region offer floor escalation - Bengaluru candidate

Ben / Karthik —

I support proceeding with Option B (12% sign-on), with one modification: reduce the sign-on to 10% gross to keep the one-time cash exposure conservative while remaining competitive. Rationale: preserves our global band integrity (avoid permanent band creep) but still addresses the urgency.

Action items I’m putting in motion:
- I’ve created a quick comp impact sheet and ticket for approvals: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3c-redwood-comp-impact and HR ticket HR-HIRE-3242.
- Evelyn, please confirm the local tax treatment and whether we should gross up the payment or pay net (I recommend gross to avoid candidate surprise).
- Ben, confirm you’ll back this in case finance pushes for justification — I’ll route to comp_signoff@redwood.ai once Evelyn confirms.

If everyone signs off by EOD Monday (24 May), recruiting can send the formal offer with a DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Raza Gupta <raza@talentbridge.io>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@gmail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Offer: Senior ML Engineer - Redwood Inference (Bengaluru)

Raza / Priya —

Good news: People Ops has approved a one-time sign-on to close Priya. We will proceed with a 10% gross sign-on (as discussed internally) in lieu of a base uplift. The full offer will follow via DocuSign later today. Key terms to expect:

- Base salary: INR-denominated equivalent to the top of our standard band (USD-equivalent quoted in offer).
- Sign-on: 10% of base, paid 50% on day 1 and 50% at 6 months; grossed up per comp team's guidance.
- Equity: standard new-hire RSU grant for level; vesting schedule in offer.
- Start date: flexible within 4 weeks — please indicate preferred start.

Ben/Marissa/Evelyn — thanks for the quick turnaround. Raza, please confirm candidate availability for signing and preferred start window; I’ll route the DocuSign once I have that.

Best,
Karthik
Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
